title: See each sync step as it runs, with a clear result when it ends
summary: Sync now and the first sync after connecting Microsoft 365 now show a live checklist of the steps finished so far and the elapsed time. The Overview also follows a sync that is already running, such as the nightly sync, and refreshes the figures when it ends. A short confirmation shows when the sync finished, and a failed or refused sync shows a clear message below the page header with a link to the sync history.
